greeting_message.description: The greeting message the agent will open the conversation with. You can add variables in curly brackets (for example, \{your-variable}).

greeting_message_human_talk_timeout.description: The maximum number of seconds the agent waits for the human to speak first when `greeting_message_mode` is set to `human`. If the human does not speak within this time, the agent will start the conversation automatically.

initial_pause_seconds.description: Duration before the agent starts speaking.

interruption_fade_out.description: Each frame is 20 ms. When you interrupt the bot, the volume slowly goes down to 0 over that many frames. For example, 5 translates to a 100 ms fadeout.

is_transcript_disabled.description: If set to true, conversations will not be transcribed.

language.description: This agent's language. For the list of available languages, see Supported languages

min_words_to_interrupt.description: You can set how many words the human must speak before the AI will stop speaking and listening.

noise_cancellation.description: Removes background noise on the caller's side. `advanced` (Voice Isolation) filters more aggressively than `standard`. Defaults to `advanced`.

out_hours_action.description: ID of the action that handles inbound calls outside `working_hours`. It must be a call transfer or a custom action in the agent's workspace, and it does not need to be attached to the agent. `null` declines the call. prompt.description: Add variables in curly brackets. For example, \{your-variable}.

realistic_filler_words.description: If enabled, the agent will be using realistic filler words (for example, "um").

reminder_after_idle_time_seconds.description: Time in seconds before sending an idle reminder.

ring_pause_seconds.description: Ring time before the agent answers the call.

suppression_level.description: Strength of Voice Isolation, from 0 to 1. Only takes effect when `noise_cancellation` is `advanced`. Defaults to `1` on create. See [how values map to Strength in the app](/call-configuration#strength).

transcriber_keywords.description: Add business terms to improve accuracy and recognition.

voice_prompt.description: Slightly alters the agent's intonation, talking speed or sentiment for a subtle yet noticeable effect.

voice_similarity_boost.description: Range 0 to 1. Determines how closely the AI matches the original voice. Higher settings potentially including unwanted noise from the original recording.

voice_speed.description: Adjust how fast or slow your agent will talk on the call.

voice_stability.description: Range is 0 to 1. Lower settings may make the voice sound more expressive but less predictable, while higher settings make it sound steadier but less emotional.

voice_style.description: Range 0 to 1. Enhances the distinct characteristics of the original voice, but may slow down processing and make the voice less stable.

voice_synthesizer.description: The engine used to synthesize voice.

voice_volume.description: Adjust how loud or quite your agent will talk on the call.

telephony_rtp_mos_lan.description: Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for the LAN (internal) leg, from 1.0 (worst) to 5.0 (best). Returned as `null` when no RTCP-derived stats are available for the leg.

telephony_rtp_mos_wan.description: Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for the WAN (PSTN/carrier) leg, from 1.0 (worst) to 5.0 (best). Returned as `null` when no RTCP-derived stats are available for the leg.

telephony_rtp_rtt_lan_ms.description: Round-trip time (RTT) over the LAN (internal) leg in milliseconds, derived from RTCP. Returned as `null` when no RTCP-derived stats are available for the leg.

telephony_rtp_rtt_wan_ms.description: Round-trip time (RTT) over the WAN (PSTN/carrier) leg in milliseconds, derived from RTCP. Returned as `null` when the remote endpoint sends no RTCP or the media does not traverse the media relay (the key is still present, not omitted).
